messages.title: Faaslo ki shruyaat
messages.message:
Me usually apne asli halat ki jaga I'm fine bolta hoo, lekin ye meri life ka wo din tha jab me anjaan logo ko bhi apni true condition batane lag gya, ek friend ne to mujhe majnu bulana shru ker diya, me kasam khata reha ke hum sirf friends he, ab kiya bolu GenZ mindset ko, me bht akela feel ker reha tha, honestly life me pahli baar us din Islamiat ke book ke 40 page padh liye, sirf khud ko busy rakhne ke liye, ye ek/do din ki baat nhi 1.5 hafta yahi condition chalty rehi thi, me khud ko blkl akela feel ker reha tha. 
 Aap ke jaane ke baad mere 4 aur friends ese hee bina reason ke chale gaye.

messages.title: Anjane milte he, wo ek din chale jaate he lekin yaad bht aate he
messages.message:
10 din baad her jaga khamoshi thi, college ke holidays khatam ho gayi thi, is baat per mujhe pahli baar khushi hue thi ke ab ghar se bahir jauga to mood change hoga, studies m koi khaas dilchaspy nhi thi sara din ese hee nikal gya, wapis ghar aaya aur aake so gya, pahle sirf ek nap leta tha ab ye meri addiction ban gayi he, lekin ab tak ek kaam mene acha ker diya ke mene apna store ek working site per open ker diya, paisa, deen, fitness, social skills, studies, start paise se kerdi aur apna store bana liya, lekin me focus nhi ker paa reha. dost to chale hee gaye ab to Leo bhi ghar chhod ke baag gaya, meri galaty thi me uska theek se khayal nhi rakh paya, ulta us per gusa kerta tha 
 in 10 dino m mere pass batane ko kuch khaas nhi.

messages.title: Mere 6 weeks baad ke halat
messages.message: aaj almost 7 weeks ho gaye he, wese sach bol reha hoo, 2 khawab aagaye he ab tak, to shruyat ese hoty he last week mene apna pahla ek full-stack software deploy kerdiya jo abhi mere laptop m run ho reha he, wo software mene college m present kiya, jiski wajah se ab me apne poore college ka STEM comptition me lead character ka role play ker reha hoo, uske saath mene friday maths ki classes bhi apne dad ke school m lena shru kerdi, aur dad ke friend ke saath jo ek youtuber he aur maths ka teacher bhi, unke saath kaam kerne ki bhi offer mili he, wo chahite he ke me unke liye website build kru, aapse kiya doosra wada paiso m aage barho ke kisi ki zaroorat na pade, uski shruyat is week kerdi, inshallah aage bhi behter hoga, is week mujhe batane ke liye yahi he
